Device NVIDIA H800 (GH100)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- --------------- --------------- ----------------------------------------------------------------------
Metric Name                                                                 Metric Type     Metric Unit     Metric Description                                                    
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- --------------- --------------- ----------------------------------------------------------------------
branch_inst_executed                                                        Counter         branches        Number of unique branch targets assigned to the instruction,          
                                                                                                            including both divergent and uniform branches.                        
derived__avg_thread_executed                                                Counter         thread          Average number of thread-level executed instructions per warp         
                                                                                                            (regardless of their predicate). Computed as: thread_inst_executed /  
                                                                                                            inst_executed                                                         
derived__avg_thread_executed_true                                           Counter         thread          Average number of predicated-on thread-level executed instructions    
                                                                                                            per warp. Computed as: thread_inst_executed_true / inst_executed      
derived__derivative_avg_thread_executed_true                                Counter         thread          Derivative of the derived__avg_thread_executed_true metric.           
                                                                                                            Difference between the current and the previous address in average    
                                                                                                            number of predicated-on thread-level executed instructions per warp.  
derived__local_spilling_requests                                            Counter                         Number of executed instructions and requests made to L1 for register  
                                                                                                            spilling to local memory.                                             
derived__local_spilling_requests_pct                                        Throughput      %               Percentage of total local memory requests to L1 that are due to       
                                                                                                            register spilling.                                                    
derived__memory_l1_conflicts_shared_nway                                    Counter                         Average N-way conflict in L1 per shared memory instruction. A 1-way   
                                                                                                            access has no conflicts and resolves in a single pass. Computed as:   
                                                                                                            memory_l1_wavefronts_shared / inst_executed                           
derived__memory_l1_wavefronts_shared_excessive                              Counter                         Excessive number of wavefronts in L1 from shared memory instructions, 
                                                                                                            because not all not predicated-off threads performed the operation.   
derived__memory_l2_theoretical_sectors_global_excessive                     Counter         byte            Excessive theoretical number of sectors requested in L2 from global   
                                                                                                            memory instructions, because not all not predicated-off threads       
                                                                                                            performed the operation.                                              
derived__shared_spilling_requests                                           Counter                         Number of executed instructions and requests made to shared memory    
                                                                                                            for register spilling.                                                
derived__shared_spilling_requests_pct                                       Throughput      %               Percentage of total requests to shared memory that are due to         
                                                                                                            register spilling.                                                    
inst_executed                                                               Counter         inst            Number of warp-level executed instructions, ignoring instruction      
                                                                                                            predicates. Warp-level means the values increased by one per          
                                                                                                            individual warp executing the instruction, independent of the number  
                                                                                                            of participating threads within each warp.                            
memory_access_size_type                                                     Counter                         The size of the memory access, in bits.                               
memory_access_type                                                          Counter                         The type of memory access (e.g. load or store).                       
memory_l1_tag_requests_global                                               Counter         sectors         Number of L1 tag requests generated by global memory instructions.    
memory_l1_wavefronts_shared                                                 Counter         sectors         Number of wavefronts in L1 from shared memory instructions.           
memory_l1_wavefronts_shared_ideal                                           Counter         sectors         Ideal number of wavefronts in L1 from shared memory instructions,     
                                                                                                            assuming each not predicated-off thread performed the operation.      
memory_l2_theoretical_sectors_global                                        Counter         sectors         Theoretical number of sectors requested in L2 from global memory      
                                                                                                            instructions.                                                         
memory_l2_theoretical_sectors_global_ideal                                  Counter         sectors         Ideal number of sectors requested in L2 from global memory            
                                                                                                            instructions, assuming each not predicated-off thread performed the   
                                                                                                            operation.                                                            
memory_l2_theoretical_sectors_local                                         Counter         sectors         Theoretical number of sectors requested in L2 from local memory       
                                                                                                            instructions.

sass__inst_executed_global_stores                                           Counter         inst            Number of global memory store instructions executed.
